name: query_hit_preservation_floor
data: existing hard-confirmatory OFF exact-wire trajectories and already-produced matched replay outputs
motivation: A strict-valid natural search exposure showed that a record containing an identifier explicitly requested by the current retrieval query could still be dropped by lossy search compression.
algorithm: parse the current rg/grep search pattern
extract only conservative structured identifiers: identifiers containing underscore, CamelCase identifiers, or identifiers explicitly introduced by def/class in the search pattern
do not treat generic bare words, regex fragments, paths, globs, warning/error words, or prose terms as preservation anchors
use exact identifier-boundary matching against each search-result record
if a record contains at least one preservation anchor, KEEP it regardless of learned relevance
all other records retain the existing query-only baseline decision
primary_metrics: historical-fix-adjacent record recall before and after the floor
baseline DROP to floor KEEP historical-fix-adjacent rescues
historical-fix-adjacent fraction among newly retained record exposures
interpretation_limits: this probe is post-hoc because the failure mode was observed before defining the floor
historical-fix-adjacent is a proxy and not causal ground truth
record-token additions estimate retention cost but are not exact final folded-output token counts
no agent task-success claim is made
